hypothesis: An authored graph exclusion rule makes the prior measured regression change the available origins. The MCP agent reads the rule output and cites the prior outcome, then proposes a surviving origin different from v3-retry. This tests use of connected evidence, not autonomous learning or policy improvement.
budget_explanation: Unchanged v2 PPO rollout rounding: 60000 requested, 61440 consumed. No training budget change.
process_pass_criteria: Actual LLM calls rank_origins_excluding_regressed and both existing outcome tools over MCP
Proposal cites v2 outcome ID, excluded previous origin and regression-lineage-exclusion-v1
Chosen origin survives the fresh graph guardrail and differs from v3-retry
Exactly 61440 PPO steps and all 180 canonical validation episodes complete
Decision, full MCP trace, gate and connected outcome are saved
candidate_pass_criteria: Pass all four unchanged promo-1 checks. Report parent-child collision and goal deltas separately. A gate pass alone establishes no improvement.
interpretation: Report whether the origin changed and whether any suite regressed. No learning, causal planner advantage, physical safety or parent improvement claim from this single run.
failure_policy: One attempt and one proposal only. No second training attempt, fallback or substitute even if a provider, guardrail, worker or gate fails. Preserve all failure receipts.
safe_start_condition: Idle public worker, healthy FalkorDB, adequate AWS disk/memory, and at least 600 seconds before cutoff. Existing 120-second agent and 480-second worker limits remain.

context_budgets.token_bound_method: UTF-8 byte count is a conservative byte-BPE text-token upper bound; no tokenizer estimate
context_budgets.summary_policy: Top-ranked candidate rows, observed regression rows first, exact IDs and per-suite deltas; omitted rows labelled. Full graph properties fetchable by ID and full results retained in Decision.

expected_outcome: The physics-20261016150004-25da9c origin is excluded by recorded regression edges/outcomes; the agent chooses a remaining compatible complete-evidence origin. Training or validation may still fail or regress.
origin_rule: Exclude self or ancestors (up to eight hops) at either endpoint of REGRESSED_AGAINST or associated with not_released_regression; exclude unexamined deeper lineage. Rank surviving origins by failed-suite count ascending, minimum collision clearance descending, then ID. Missing observations are not safety.
release_policy: Never change deployed weights. Report unchanged promo-1 separately from the existing child-parent regression comparison; a gate pass can still be not_released_regression.
